## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

[More][58]

prosthetics.

the perfect balance of comfort, flexibility, and stability for prosthetic users. This socket
combines a soft flexible inner socket with a strong laminated outer frame, allowing better comfort
while maintaining structural support during walking and daily activities. 



The flexible inner material adapts comfortably to the residual limb, reducing pressure points and
improving socket comfort, while the rigid laminated frame provides durability, stability, and
efficient weight transfer. This design helps improve suspension, limb control, and overall mobility
for both below-knee and above-knee prosthetic users.

#### PROSTHETIC FUNCTION

Prosthetic feet play a crucial role in helping individuals with limb loss regain their mobility and
perform daily activities. To effectively mimic the functionality of a natural foot, prosthetic feet
are designed to fulfill specific requirements.



Firstly, prosthetic feet must act as shock absorbers. When the amputee's residual limb strikes the
ground, the prosthetic foot should absorb the impact forces, minimizing stress on the rest of the
body. This feature helps prevent discomfort, reduce the likelihood of joint injuries, and enhance
overall comfort while walking or running.



Additionally, prosthetic feet need to adapt to uneven terrain. They should provide stability and
adjust to different surfaces, such as slopes, stairs, or rough ground. This adaptability allows
users to maintain balance and avoid stumbling or falling, providing them with the confidence to
navigate various environments.



Furthermore, prosthetic feet must facilitate a smooth rollover from heel to toe during the gait
cycle. This characteristic closely resembles the natural motion of the foot. It enables individuals
to efficiently transfer their weight forward, ensuring a fluid and natural walking or running
pattern.



Finally, prosthetic feet need to provide a rigid lever for propelling forward during toe-off. After
the heel strikes the ground and the foot rolls over, the prosthetic foot should facilitate push-off
power to mimic the propulsive action of the natural foot. This aspect aids in enhancing the walking
or running efficiency, enabling individuals to move with greater ease and speed.



The design and engineering of prosthetic feet have evolved significantly in recent years,
incorporating advanced materials, biomechanical principles, and sophisticated technologies. These
advancements aim to meet the diverse needs and preferences of individuals with limb loss, enabling
them to lead active and fulfilling lives.

What happens after the amputation?

prosthesis is never as natural as your own limb, it can help you to do many things quite effectively
if you are willing to combine your energy and willpower into learning how to use it.

of your concerns, and then to work with them on the processes of design, fitting and training, which
are required to be a successful user

# Get The Best Prosthetic and Orthotic Care in Texas at LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and
# Prosthetics

Amputees and those needing orthotic bracing today have unlimited choices of products and care.
Nowhere is this more noticeable than at LeTourneau Lifelike [Orthotics][27] and [Prosthetics][28],
Inc. Our family-owned company has provided advanced prosthetic and orthotic care for over three
decades to adult and pediatric patients. We have received the highest awards for care and service,
in a friendly, caring setting for both you and your family.

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has pioneered many advanced O&P innovations by
developing unique products such as Perfect Skin™, the [Neutralizer Knee Brace][29]™, the Stealth
Brace™ and the Acti-Ankle™. Our trained, experienced and knowledgeable team will be happy to assist
you or a loved one.

# About LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics

Get the very best prosthetic technology and advanced orthotics in Texas at LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics. World renowned experts with superior service. LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics was founded in Beaumont, Texas and expanded to Jasper and Nederland, TX.
Word spread rapidly of the quality care, and superior customer service that Tom LeTourneau and his
staff were providing patients. Requests poured in from surrounding communities for that same quality
care and customer service. [(Read more)][30]

# The Most Advanced Technology

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in orthoses and prostheses design and
management in Texas. They designed both the Te-Evolution and Perfect Skin. They also developed the
Ultra-G Fabrication technique used in orthotic design. The highly trained and certified
professionals at LeTourneau continually utilize [(Read More) ][31]

# i-Limb Hand

The [i-LIMB Hand][32]. The world’s first fully articulating and commercially available bionic
hand. LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in advanced upper-limb prosthetics
(ULP). While LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has provided myoelectric prosthetics for
years, three new products now are commercially available. The i-LIMB hand, from Touch Bionics, is a
first-to-market prosthetic device with five individually powered digits. This artificial limb looks
and acts like a real human hand and represents a generational advance in bionics and patient
care. [(Read more)][33]

# LeTourneau Kids

“Those are our kids, too,” says Tom LeTourneau, whose company has helped countless infants,
children, adolescents as well as teens overcome physical disabilities over the years. “We basically
adopt all the kids who need our services. Our motto for all pediatric cases is, ‘Let’s face it … 
TOGETHER.’ We want to be there for the long haul and help our kids reach their full potential.”

Through advanced technology, an intra-team discipline and more than 125 years of combined
experience, LeTourneau KIDS offers the best pediatric prosthetic and orthotic program available
anywhere in the world. ([Read More][34])

hand. LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in advanced upper-limb prosthetics
(ULP). While LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has provided myoelectric prosthetics for
years, three new products now are commercially available. The i-LIMB hand, from Touch Bionics, is a
first-to-market prosthetic device with five individually powered digits. This artificial limb looks
and acts like a real human hand and represents a generational advance in bionics and patient
care. [(Read more)][33]

# LeTourneau Kids

“Those are our kids, too,” says Tom LeTourneau, whose company has helped countless infants,
children, adolescents as well as teens overcome physical disabilities over the years. “We basically
adopt all the kids who need our services. Our motto for all pediatric cases is, ‘Let’s face it … 
TOGETHER.’ We want to be there for the long haul and help our kids reach their full potential.”

Through advanced technology, an intra-team discipline and more than 125 years of combined
experience, LeTourneau KIDS offers the best pediatric prosthetic and orthotic program available
anywhere in the world. ([Read More][34])

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

## the impact
## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## We are Meril. We are committed to addressing unmet clinical needs around the world through our 
## innovative and path-breaking medical devices.

Consciously contributing to alleviate ailments, we partner with the global medical fraternity across
various specialties.

## Founded in 2006

Meril is an India-based, global medical device company that is dedicated to design and manufacture
clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

## Our Purpose

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,
including cardiovascular, orthopedics, robotics, diagnostics, and oncology, aimed at alleviating
human suffering.

We believe in the power of asking questions. For every "if only…", in the field of surgical and
medical intervention, we at Meril hope to turn it into a "what if…" with infinite possibilities &
outcomes.

## advancements

me."

Welcome to Ottobock

## We define and shape Human Empowerment – today and tomorrow.

Ottobock is a global medical technology company based in Germany, specializing in prosthetics,
orthotics, and mobility solutions. Founded in 1919, it focuses on improving quality of life through
innovation, advanced biomechanics, and personalized patient care worldwide.

## Products and Services

Prosthetic and Orthotic Solutions fabricates prosthetic limbs (artificial limbs) braces and a
variety of orthotic devices for patients of all ages in our state-of-the-art technical lab.
Patient-centered care is a hallmark of our practice. We are proud to serve Western Massachusetts and
the Greater Hartford area.

## About Us

Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions aims to enhance the quality of life for all of our patients. We
fabricate prosthetic (artificial) limbs, braces, and a variety of orthotic devices for patients of
all ages in our state-of-the-art technical lab. Patient-centered care is a hallmark of our practice.

[Learn More][39]
Two locations to serve you...
West Springfield MA 413-785-4047 & Northampton MA 413-614-1000

## Meet Our Team

At Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions, we believe that successful outcomes begin with
patient-practitioner relationships built on trust and honest communication. Great care goes into
matching patients with a practitioner who will be the right fit for them, whether they are here for
a short-term need or life-long condition. We are a team of problem solvers with exceptional skills
and experience in our respective areas of expertise.

[Learn More][40]

## Prosthetics

Our team appreciates the unique circumstances that bring each patient to us; experiences with
amputation are deeply personal and the path to recovery looks different for each person. Healing
from surgery, design and fit of a prosthetic device, and rehabilitation time vary by individual, but
each phase requires patience and persistence. We are here to listen, to problem solve, and to
celebrate the confidence you discover along the way – both with your device and within yourself.

[Learn More][41]

## Building a Community of Support

Hannah's Story

Our relationship with Hannah and her family began when she was just six months old. Now a vibrant,
tenacious preschooler, Hannah is achieving mobility goals and spreading joy wherever she goes. As is
true for many children, Hannah’s journey involves a team of people who are working together to
support her growth and development, and we are proud to be a part of her team. The comfort Hannah
and her family feel when they walk through our doors is our goal with every family we work with.

[Learn More][42]
Already a patient? Let us know about your experience.
[Patient Satisfaction Survey][43]

## About Us

Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions aims to enhance the quality of life for all of our patients. We
fabricate prosthetic (artificial) limbs, braces, and a variety of orthotic devices for patients of
all ages in our state-of-the-art technical lab. Patient-centered care is a hallmark of our practice.

[Learn More][39]
Two locations to serve you...
West Springfield MA 413-785-4047 & Northampton MA 413-614-1000

## Meet Our Team

At Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions, we believe that successful outcomes begin with
patient-practitioner relationships built on trust and honest communication. Great care goes into
matching patients with a practitioner who will be the right fit for them, whether they are here for
a short-term need or life-long condition. We are a team of problem solvers with exceptional skills
and experience in our respective areas of expertise.

[Learn More][40]

## Prosthetics

Our team appreciates the unique circumstances that bring each patient to us; experiences with
amputation are deeply personal and the path to recovery looks different for each person. Healing
from surgery, design and fit of a prosthetic device, and rehabilitation time vary by individual, but
each phase requires patience and persistence. We are here to listen, to problem solve, and to
celebrate the confidence you discover along the way – both with your device and within yourself.

[Learn More][41]

## Building a Community of Support

Hannah's Story

Our relationship with Hannah and her family began when she was just six months old. Now a vibrant,
tenacious preschooler, Hannah is achieving mobility goals and spreading joy wherever she goes. As is
true for many children, Hannah’s journey involves a team of people who are working together to
support her growth and development, and we are proud to be a part of her team. The comfort Hannah
and her family feel when they walk through our doors is our goal with every family we work with.

# Precision. Performance. Possibility.

Thank you for taking the time to learn about our unique approach to prosthetic patient care. Whether
you're a patient, caregiver, physician, therapist, case manager, or insurance representative, we
look forward to introducing you to a more holistic, individualized care experience.
 

At Prosthetic & Orthotic Associates, our team proudly serves patients across New York, Connecticut,
New Jersey, and Pennsylvania with a commitment to excellence in prosthetic and orthotic care.


Our patient-centered approach prioritizes each individual's needs, because there is no
one-size-fits-all solution. The POA Patient Care Process draws on our team's collective expertise to
deliver customized prosthetic solutions that support mobility, independence, and quality of life.
 

We work closely with every patient, tailoring prosthetics and rehabilitation plans to align with
their goals. We call them "Handspring Heroes" because we celebrate their resilience and
achievements.
 

At POA, we believe prosthetic care should consider the whole person, empowering you to live your
best life.

[Explore Our Care ][30]
[Screenshot 2025-04-28 125505.png]

## Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions Designed for You

At POA, we believe prosthetic and orthotic care should go beyond simply replacing lost function—it
should enhance your mobility, independence, and overall well-being. Our approach focuses on you as a
whole person, not just one aspect of your condition.


With expertise spanning a wide range of prosthetic and orthotic solutions, we tailor each device to
fit your unique goals, needs, and lifestyle. Whether you require a high-performance prosthesis for
an active lifestyle, a lightweight everyday solution, or specialized orthotic support, our team
works closely with you to ensure the best possible outcome.


By integrating cutting-edge technology, advanced materials, and personalized rehabilitation plans,
we help you move forward with confidence—because the right solution is the one designed just for
you.

## Advanced Design


POA began with a simple idea and a commitment to change. Our medical professionals set out to
enhance the patient care experience while incorporating the latest advancements in upper limb
prosthetic technology. This approach allows us to create custom solutions tailored to each
individual's needs.


We have been hard at work integrating 3D printing and scanning into our process, expanding
possibilities and improving patient outcomes.


Discover what we’ve been working on.

[Explore ][41]
[processed-CD969A00-D1F1-4D0F-9636-64D27BCA452F.jpeg]

## Empowering Mobility, Transforming Lives

At POA, we believe every step matters—whether it’s a child’s first steps, an athlete’s return to
movement, or simply getting back to everyday activities with confidence. Our team is here to support
you with personalized prosthetic care designed to fit your unique needs and goals.

 

Stay inspired—follow us on social media for stories, support, and strides forward!

## We Use Direct Socket System Technology

Discover the unparalleled benefits of our custom-made direct sockets at PrimeCare Orthotics &
Prosthetics.

[[two doctors install a prosthesis for a woman.]
][107]
[leg prosthesis installation.]

Engineered for optimal structural integrity and energy transfer, our direct sockets revolutionize
your prosthetic experience. Experience a 30% increase in patient comfort with our innovative
solutions, crafted to fit your unique residual limb. Enjoy the convenience of same-day service
without compromising on quality. Our prosthetists in New Mexico carefully tailor each direct socket
to ensure the perfect balance of comfort and support, accelerating your rehabilitation journey and
enabling earlier gait training.

[
Read More About Direct Socket Technology
][108]

## Adjustable Prosthetic Sockets: Now More Accessible


We at PrimeCare offer adjustable socket solutions to help patients manage limb volume changes,
swelling, looseness, and daily fit challenges. With recent Medicare and insurance coverage updates,
these advanced prosthetic socket options have become more accessible for eligible patients.

# Custom Orthotics & Prosthetics in New Mexico

Since 2009, PrimeCare has empowered New Mexico residents to regain mobility, independence, and
confidence. From custom lower-limb prosthetic legs to advanced upper-limb prosthetics and orthotic
solutions, our personalized care helps patients stay active at home, at work, and within their
communities.

## Welcome to PrimeCare Orthotics & Prosthetics

PrimeCare Orthotics & Prosthetics has been a leading provider of custom upper-limb and lower-limb
prosthetics in New Mexico since 2009. Our expert bilingual team offers compassionate care and
cutting-edge technology to enhance mobility and improve quality of life.

From custom prosthetic legs to hand prosthetics and orthotic devices, we tailor our services to meet
each client’s unique requirements. We strive to make each appointment a positive and memorable
experience, whether you are here for a single visit or require lifelong care.

Trust PrimeCare for expert craftsmanship, personalized attention, and comprehensive support on your
journey to greater independence and mobility.

## We Use Direct Socket System Technology

Discover the unparalleled benefits of our custom-made direct sockets at PrimeCare Orthotics &
Prosthetics.

[[two doctors install a prosthesis for a woman.]
][107]
[leg prosthesis installation.]

Engineered for optimal structural integrity and energy transfer, our direct sockets revolutionize
your prosthetic experience. Experience a 30% increase in patient comfort with our innovative
solutions, crafted to fit your unique residual limb. Enjoy the convenience of same-day service
without compromising on quality. Our prosthetists in New Mexico carefully tailor each direct socket
to ensure the perfect balance of comfort and support, accelerating your rehabilitation journey and
enabling earlier gait training.

### THE POSI PROCESS

1. Evaluation and Plan

The first part of the [POSI Process][131] consists of important questions about your hobbies and
daily activities etc. On top of that, we will give you a physical evaluation to test general muscle
strength and flexibility.

2. Hand Casting

This is the first step in fitting and will involve an impression of the residual limb. The hand cast
will be made using a plaster to create a model to be modified to fit each specific patient.

3. Diagnostic Fittings

During the diagnostic fitting, it allows us to continue to adjust to any changes that might need to
be made throughout the alignment process as well as make it more comfortable overall.

4. In-House Fabrication

In-House Fabrication simply makes it easier to make adjustments on site while you wait as well as
quick feedback.

5. Delivery

Once everything is completed the delivery of prosthesis will happen and we will continue to monitor
your progress and follow-up.

6. Coordinated Rehab

The final step involves making sure that you are using your new prosthetic to the highest potential
that you are capable of through prosthetic rehab.

Quality

At Proted, quality is not a matter of course, but instead the result of many years of experience and
a continuous improvement process.

Network

Proted Global makes users happy by exporting to 63 countries and 5 continents. We aim to become a
worldwide brand with our qualified network.

Production

Our production activities are Prosthetic orthosis and workshop machines. We provide production with
our technological machinery parkour.

Technology

We produce many different production technologies in the field of prosthetic orthotics in our Ankara
factory, Turkey.

Customer Happiness

We care about our customer relations, we respond to their demands by meeting their demands quickly

### Engineering Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions Since 1992

Proted’s vision is to produce the highest quality prosthetic and orthotic products in order to meet
the needs of disabled people and increase their general life quality.

Proted provides quality-certified services and has been awarded with a state grant for its advanced
technology infrastructure among leading manufacturing companies in Türkiye. Since becoming an
officially approved R&D Center by the Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology in 2017, Proted
has focused on high-technology research and development projects in the prosthetics and orthotics
sector.

Proted’s vision is to produce high-quality prosthetic and orthotic products that improve mobility,
independence, and overall quality of life for people with disabilities.

Operating from its integrated manufacturing facility in Ankara, Türkiye, Proted develops and
manufactures a wide range of prosthetic and orthotic technologies through its in-house engineering,
CNC machining, composite Carbon production, silicone processing, investment casting, and digital
manufacturing infrastructure.

Today, Proted exports and supplies its products to many countries across Europe, the Balkans, the
Baltic region, Africa, the Middle East, Canada, Turkic Republics, Asia, and the Far East, continuing
to expand its global presence with innovative and regionally manufactured high-technology solutions.

### Engineering Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions Since 1992

Proted’s vision is to produce the highest quality prosthetic and orthotic products in order to meet
the needs of disabled people and increase their general life quality.

Proted provides quality-certified services and has been awarded with a state grant for its advanced
technology infrastructure among leading manufacturing companies in Türkiye. Since becoming an
officially approved R&D Center by the Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology in 2017, Proted
has focused on high-technology research and development projects in the prosthetics and orthotics
sector.

Proted’s vision is to produce high-quality prosthetic and orthotic products that improve mobility,
independence, and overall quality of life for people with disabilities.

Operating from its integrated manufacturing facility in Ankara, Türkiye, Proted develops and
manufactures a wide range of prosthetic and orthotic technologies through its in-house engineering,
CNC machining, composite Carbon production, silicone processing, investment casting, and digital
manufacturing infrastructure.

Today, Proted exports and supplies its products to many countries across Europe, the Balkans, the
Baltic region, Africa, the Middle East, Canada, Turkic Republics, Asia, and the Far East, continuing
to expand its global presence with innovative and regionally manufactured high-technology solutions.

## What You Can Achieve with Our Scanners

Discover the ways in which integrating our scanners into your workflow can enhance efficiency and
help you achieve remarkable results.
* [ Talk to our experts ][131]
* #### Quality Inspection
  
  3D scanners for quality inspection have revolutionized quality control by replacing slow, manual
  gauging with rapid, high-precision automated inspection. This non-destructive testing method
  drastically accelerates inspection cycles, reduces waste, and ensures absolute compliance with
  strict tolerances.
* #### Reverse Engineering
  
  3D scanners make reverse engineering faster and more accurate by converting existing parts and
  prototypes into editable CAD models. This digital workflow preserves precise geometry, simplifies
  redesigns, and helps teams modernize legacy components efficiently.
* #### Digital Archiving & Documentation
  
  3D scanners for digital archiving and documentation are vital for creating flawless, permanent
  digital records of historical artifacts, museum collections, architectural sites and others.
  High-resolution 3D models ensures that history is accurately preserved and globally accessible for
  generations to come.
* #### Product Development & Design
  
  3D scanners for product development and design accelerate the innovation cycle by seamlessly
  transitioning physical concepts into digital workflows. This allows for rapid iteration, complex
  surface modeling, and seamless integration into computer-aided styling (CAS) workflows. By
  capturing real-world geometry instantly, design teams can skip tedious manual measurements, reduce
  time-to-market, and optimize products for both form and function.
* #### Human Body Scanning & Medical Digitization
  
  3D scanners for human body scanning and medical digitization have transformed healthcare by
  creating highly accurate, contact-free 3D models of the human anatomy. 3D scanning technology
  enhances patient comfort, streamlines manufacturing workflows, and elevates personalization in
  patient care.
* #### Research & Education
  
  3D scanners for research and education serve as powerful tools for experiential learning and
  advanced data analysis. In the classroom, they bring abstract concepts to life, allowing students
  in engineering, manufacturing, and archaeology to interact with precise digital replicas of
  complex objects. For researchers, they provide accurate, quantifiable data for geometric analysis,
  product evaluation, and computer simulations.
* #### And More to Discover!

Core component design technology for cameras, projectors, and wireless computing modules
Integrated opto-mechatronics and computing control system
Real-time stereo reconstruction algorithm for 3D vision
3D geometric modeling, data processing software and certified, customized inspection module
High-accuracy calibration technology for 3D optical measurement

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

Our sole focus is having positive patient outcomes! We provide advanced prosthetic & orthotic
solutions to improve your life!

[
Contact Summit O&PContact Summit O&P
][18]

## Improving Lives & Lifestyles!

Summit takes great pride in patient care. Here, you are not just another number! Oregon Based
Business: Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics is a locally-owned orthotic and prosthetic practice serving
Oregon since 1979. Our mission is to provide our community with the highest level of orthotic and
prosthetic care available using the latest technology and resources.

### Orthotics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides custom and off-the-shelf upper and lower extremity
orthotics.

[
Custom OrthoticsCustom Orthotics
][19]

### Prosthetics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides a variety of prosthetic services and care.

[
Prosthetics CareProsthetics Care
][20]

### Message from Todd

Having a family member as an amputee allows me to see the daily challenges of an amputee.

[
Message from ToddMessage from Todd
][21]

### Wounded Warriors

Summit O and P is a proud supporter and partner of the Wounded Warrior Project.

[
Wounded WarriorsWounded Warriors
][22]

## We Are Located in 9 Cities

# People of All Ages Welcome

We take time to listen to the needs of each of our patients, making sure we hear what is important.
We want to give you hope, that there is a better life ahead! We celebrate your successes and look to
build lasting relationships with our clients.

[
Discover a Place Near YouDiscover a Place Near You
][23]

##### Orthotics

Summit O&P works with your healthcare team for the best Orthotic solution.

Custom Orthotics

##### Prosthetics

Summit O&P prosthetics provide the best fit for a comfortable and mobile lifestyle.

Prosthetics Care

##### Resources

Life throws curveballs at us, and we hope to provide helpful information.

Mobility Resources

## Proudly serving our Veterans!

Many of our veterans have paid a tremendous price for their dedication, duty, and love of country.
We value each and every one of them and are more than grateful for their service. All of us at
Summit O and P are proud to be a part of their journey toward wellness and to assist them in
overcoming the challenges they face in gaining back their mobility. We will use the highest level of
orthotic and prosthetic care available with the latest technology and resources to help them advance
in their enjoyment and quality of life.

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

Our sole focus is having positive patient outcomes! We provide advanced prosthetic & orthotic
solutions to improve your life!

[
Contact Summit O&PContact Summit O&P
][18]

## Improving Lives & Lifestyles!

Summit takes great pride in patient care. Here, you are not just another number! Oregon Based
Business: Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics is a locally-owned orthotic and prosthetic practice serving
Oregon since 1979. Our mission is to provide our community with the highest level of orthotic and
prosthetic care available using the latest technology and resources.

### Orthotics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides custom and off-the-shelf upper and lower extremity
orthotics.

[
Custom OrthoticsCustom Orthotics
][19]

### Prosthetics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides a variety of prosthetic services and care.

[
Prosthetics CareProsthetics Care
][20]

### Message from Todd

Having a family member as an amputee allows me to see the daily challenges of an amputee.

[
Message from ToddMessage from Todd
][21]

### Wounded Warriors

Summit O and P is a proud supporter and partner of the Wounded Warrior Project.

[
Wounded WarriorsWounded Warriors
][22]

## We Are Located in 9 Cities

# People of All Ages Welcome

We take time to listen to the needs of each of our patients, making sure we hear what is important.
We want to give you hope, that there is a better life ahead! We celebrate your successes and look to
build lasting relationships with our clients.

[
Discover a Place Near YouDiscover a Place Near You
][23]

##### Orthotics

Summit O&P works with your healthcare team for the best Orthotic solution.

Custom Orthotics

##### Prosthetics

Summit O&P prosthetics provide the best fit for a comfortable and mobile lifestyle.

Prosthetics Care

##### Resources

Life throws curveballs at us, and we hope to provide helpful information.

Mobility Resources

## Proudly serving our Veterans!

Many of our veterans have paid a tremendous price for their dedication, duty, and love of country.
We value each and every one of them and are more than grateful for their service. All of us at
Summit O and P are proud to be a part of their journey toward wellness and to assist them in
overcoming the challenges they face in gaining back their mobility. We will use the highest level of
orthotic and prosthetic care available with the latest technology and resources to help them advance
in their enjoyment and quality of life.

* ### What areas do you serve?
  
  We serve the entire states of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama, including [Baton Rouge][63],
  [Shreveport][64], [Gretna][65], New Orleans, [Flowood MS][66], and [Mobile AL][67].
* ### Do you accept insurance?
  
  Yes. We accept Medicaid and most major private insurance plans. Our team will verify your benefits
  before your appointment.
* ### How long does it take to get a prosthetic or orthotic device?
  
  Once you are healed and have insurance authorization, we deliver your custom device within 7 to 14
  days.
* ### Can you come to my home?
  
  Yes. OPS offers in-home consultations, fittings, and follow-up appointments across all three
  states. We also serve nursing facilities, hospitals, and workplaces.
* ### When does OPS like to meet the amputee?
  
  We would love to meet with the amputee for a pre-amputation consultation, which is provided free
  of charge. This consultation allows us to help the amputee prepare mentally and physically for
  this new journey. We can also pair the amputee with a support partner—someone close in age who has
  successfully navigated this journey.
  
  Immediately post-operation, we will visit with a Welcome Package that introduces your patient care
  manager along with the New Amputee package. This package will educate the amputee, caregiver,
  family, or other members on what to expect. We will be happy to answer all questions regarding the
  prosthetic process. If you have any questions, please contact our nearest office.
* ### What makes OPS the leading provider for prosthetics in multiple states?
  
  OPS stands out as a leading provider for prosthetics due to our commitment to excellence and
  rigorous training standards. Our owner and practitioners have attended an ABC Accredited School
  and are ABC Certified, ensuring the highest level of expertise. ABC practitioner undergoes a
  minimum of six years of college education followed by at least two years of residency. We
  prioritize continuous education, ensuring all our providers stay up-to-date with the latest
  advancements in technology.
  
  Furthermore, OPS is proud to be a training facility for future practitioners, offering NCOPE
  accredited residency sites. This commitment to education and innovation solidifies our position as
  a trusted leader in the prosthetics industry.

  At OPS, we understand what you're experiencing and are here to help.
  
  Introducing One Step Closer, a dedicated initiative by OPS designed specifically for you. One Step
  Closer consists of seasoned amputees who are committed to offering support during your journey.
  Whether you need guidance before or after amputation, or seek emotional, mental, or physical
  support, One Step Closer is here for you. They are a valuable resource and ally, dedicated to
  helping you reach your goals.
* ### We Travel to You
  
  [Three people with a dashed-line strategic plan overhead; all in red.]
  
  While our office is equipped with all the necessary resources for optimal patient care, we
  recognize that traveling may not always be feasible for you, and sometimes, it may be impossible.
  
  At OPS, we are prepared to accommodate your needs. We offer consultations, evaluations, fittings,
  and follow-up appointments in the comfort of your own home. Alternatively, we can arrange
  transportation to and from our office, ensuring you receive the care you deserve with convenience
  in mind.
* ### Commitment to Excellence
  
  [Red outline of handshake, agreement document, and pencil, symbolizing a contract.]
  
  At Orthotic & Prosthetic Solutions, excellence is our standard for all associated practitioners.
  Our team members are required to:
  * Possess a Master's Degree in Orthotics and Prosthetics
  * Hold board certification from the American Board of Certification in Orthotics, Prosthetics, and
    Pedorthics (ABC)
  * Maintain ongoing education to stay updated on consultations and advancements in orthotics and
    prosthetics
  * Regularly collaborate with physicians and therapists to review patient care plans
  * Conduct patient care instruction seminars for nurses and therapists
  * Demonstrate a steadfast dedication to providing safe and effective patient care
  

## Outcomes and Benefits

Comprehensive support through A.M.P.S.

### FAQ
* ### What areas do you serve?
  
  We serve the entire states of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama, including [Baton Rouge][63],
  [Shreveport][64], [Gretna][65], New Orleans, [Flowood MS][66], and [Mobile AL][67].
* ### Do you accept insurance?
  
  Yes. We accept Medicaid and most major private insurance plans. Our team will verify your benefits
  before your appointment.
* ### How long does it take to get a prosthetic or orthotic device?
  
  Once you are healed and have insurance authorization, we deliver your custom device within 7 to 14
  days.
* ### Can you come to my home?
  
  Yes. OPS offers in-home consultations, fittings, and follow-up appointments across all three
  states. We also serve nursing facilities, hospitals, and workplaces.
* ### When does OPS like to meet the amputee?
  
  We would love to meet with the amputee for a pre-amputation consultation, which is provided free
  of charge. This consultation allows us to help the amputee prepare mentally and physically for
  this new journey. We can also pair the amputee with a support partner—someone close in age who has
  successfully navigated this journey.
  
  Immediately post-operation, we will visit with a Welcome Package that introduces your patient care
  manager along with the New Amputee package. This package will educate the amputee, caregiver,
  family, or other members on what to expect. We will be happy to answer all questions regarding the
  prosthetic process. If you have any questions, please contact our nearest office.
* ### What makes OPS the leading provider for prosthetics in multiple states?
  
  OPS stands out as a leading provider for prosthetics due to our commitment to excellence and
  rigorous training standards. Our owner and practitioners have attended an ABC Accredited School
  and are ABC Certified, ensuring the highest level of expertise. ABC practitioner undergoes a
  minimum of six years of college education followed by at least two years of residency. We
  prioritize continuous education, ensuring all our providers stay up-to-date with the latest
  advancements in technology.
  
  Furthermore, OPS is proud to be a training facility for future practitioners, offering NCOPE
  accredited residency sites. This commitment to education and innovation solidifies our position as
  a trusted leader in the prosthetics industry.
* ### How does our mobile platform enhance our ability to serve the community?
  
  [Three people with a dashed-line strategic plan overhead; all in red.]
  
  Are you tired of waiting hours for transportation vans? Is transportation an issue? Do you live in
  a rural area?
  
  Look no further. OPS travels throughout Louisiana, Mississippi, and is expanding into Alabama. Our
  mobile labs can come to your home, shelter, skilled nursing facility, rehab hospital, workplace,
  or any location convenient for you. With our cutting-edge technology, we can get you back to
  walking without you needing to step foot in our office.
  
  Yes, we also have brick-and-mortar locations where we accept walk-ins. These locations are
  equipped with parallel bars for dynamic alignment and adjustments. What happens if you move to a
  different part of the state? You might have to switch companies. Not with us. We are still able to
  service you, ensuring continuous care regardless of your location.

## TASKA PowerCore

#### Power Refined.

The TASKA PowerCore enables clinicians to craft elegant sockets that deliver reliable power.

[Learn More][87]

## Zeus M

#### Strong. Fast. Built for every fit.

The powerful Zeus hand is now available in both small and medium sizes and all sizes are available
with a standard quick disconnect or flex wrist. Now users have even more control, more comfort, more
possibilities.

[Zeus EQD][88]
[Zeus Flex][89]
[Aether Biomedical]

## Formula Fit: Bridging the Gap

The Formula Fit is designed for active adolescents and small adults. It delivers flexible power, low
build height, and room to grow, bridging the gap between the Formula Ultra and the Pediatric
Formula, for reliable K3–K4 performance.
